## Design

### 2026-10-30: # Own desgin?

**1.37h**

# Own desgin?
I am super excited and a little nervous to work on this project! It is the first time where I will be designing the majority of the idea, and I am excited to see where this goes!

# Project ideas
I am going to go for a Spotify Desk Display, that will show me the album art, song name, singer, and maybe the progress of the song. I want to use a touch sensor, and a TFT display module.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/8bab80f770727358841a3ffeb501dcdd2455e6d0f0e444683e931e0fff16e007.png)

# Working on the schematic

I am going to be using my already bought ESP32 Devkit to save money for other things. I connected the pins using the guide, and also added a touch sensor for input.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/00c32b6ba9587849c935ee97720fc783e97908dc9d884fea2576cda951680f59.png)

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/457d21e6-9520-4437-b219-e8a4a5bae757/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-31: # Starting Work on API and TFT Screen Firmware

**2.78h**

# Starting Work on API and TFT Screen Firmware
I started the day by looking at the coding section of the guide, and picked what libraries I was going to use.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/a54d27c964354132790c7f9960fe9e80d2d3d093ff3c33df062ba2651a4a4419.png)

I decided to choose the TFT_eSPI library since it was a good match with my ESP32. I looked at the library docs.

DOCS - > https://doc-tft-espi.readthedocs.io/starting/

I started writing test code, but I coudn't test it since I didnt have the screen...

# Wasted Time On Simulators
I spent at least 30 min trying to find a online simulator that works with my project like Tinkercad Circuits and Crikit Designer, but they did not have the parts I needed or were too much work. So of course I did the reasonable thing to do and ask AI. ( Don't have much coding experience).

# AI coding time!
I made sure I understood the core topics first before asking AI for code help. It was able to make a simple TFT_eSPI sketch, it turned out to be much simpler than I expected. so I'm done right? WRONG.

# Was adding API worth the learning curve?
I forgot that I had to get current song, artist, and other info from spotify and puch it to my ESP-32. So I read the Spotify API docs, and was ready to test when.....

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/2df70934863116f5453f1ae50127ec989fdecb0b202c20b39031ff6a30c370c2.png)

### I NEED SPOTIFY PREMIUMMMMMMM......
This was inanely frustrating, I spent all that time for it to be for nothing? As a last ditch effort, I asked AI if there was an alternative, turns out I could use Last.fm instead. So I connected my account, made a app and grabbed the API key, and plugged in to my program, and after a lot of debugging, It finally worked!

Now all I had to do was test it on the physical screen once my project gets approved.

# What's next?
Tomorrow is time for CAD-ing the case and making it all look pretty! Let
s get started!

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/e3e715b4-53dd-4f87-b598-f47a813ad01d/video.mp4)

### 2026-11-01: # Working on the enclosure

**1.63h**

# Working on the enclosure

It's finally time to do the thing that I'm good at.  3D modeling! I started by reading the measurements off the AliExpress page for my TFT screen.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/99d3ea40ff2d3f815b4a436ec80e5fc3950e4c875931f1a418e9fd2a38c68d60.png)

I really liked the design of these commercial versions that I was trying to DIY:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/253baf6fdc07cf908c8326215d168498851c02bcc2e1430f08ec7d10b39804b7.png)

So this is what my inspo will be from.

# Starting the CAD
I am again using Onshape since it is the software that I am most comfortable with. After around an hour, this is what I ended up with.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/fdaf033facc924c7fe3a3195bf6c7b1d190c273765a66aa8086bad7d6adfa12e.png)

There are three pieces in total:
* A base
* A front piece
* Back piece with space for electronics

They are all connected with pegs.

# Importing TFT screen
I used a free STEP-formatted file that was similar and imported it. After checking that it fit, this is my progress so far.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/f0c33e91e5e05262e70d9b81f41b93c8bd00af94b5ae7dd126984237c2c2dd27.png)

### 2026-11-01: # Home stretch: Shipping and Last Modeling

**3.18h**

# Home stretch: Shipping and Last Modeling
Today I finally finished up my project! I'm really proud of what I came up with. Here are the final work details...

# Finishing up CAD
I did two main things:
* Added mounting holes, breathing slits, and USB holes for the ESP-32
* Added a slide-in fit for the touch sensor

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/39c8a936afc6fd53b6eda6f38b19cfc7784b67a1a52cd590c66ef0cd11e3900c.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/eef3d83a81b61fb6b80e700dac47c4b9f80ee9e82f765fb469fc32fdcb6ebd3c.png)

# Shipping
I needed to buy everything except for the microcontroller, which I have at home; I added the CAD files. I ended up adding both the Onshape link and STEP files, but it's fine. Then, for firmware, I almost lost my Arduino sketch before finding it in a random folder. It took a long time to finish writing my sessions, making the videos, and mostly organizing my repository on GitHub. I'm still new to the platform, but I got it done.
